meta.source: USGS NLDI navigation over the NHDPlus flowline network; stitched + cut per reach by watermark.hydrology.reach_geometry. Geometry verbatim (WGS84).
caveats: Centerline geometry is real NHDPlus, display-only — no reprojection/simplification.
Mainstem/tributary reach boundaries are a proportional cut by reaches.yaml lengths.
Tier-0 screening geometry for the FlowLayer viz; not a calibrated hydraulic network.
